payload.text: Host runs on this Mac and on kovacs, for Utilz and Gtools both, book with utilz-vc (gtools-vc's word, 20 Oct), on gtools-vc's decision 59 terms: a START (sender, repo, worktree and sha or diff hash, the exact command, what it binds or starts, the expected result, the kill timeout), the GO, which alone starts a run, and an END with the results. Heavy runs go one at a time: any build or compile, any whole suite, Chrome, a dry run or cut, a daemon. One light run (no build, GUI, daemon or port; its own temp dirs only) may share the window with one heavy run at a load under 60, and a timing-like failure in it is rerun alone. A kovacs leg runs beside a Mac run, counted in the load. Bytes that change after a GO send their new hash before the rerun. Before each GO: load under 60, nothing listening on 47600 to 47799, no suite running. The day's log is ~/Devel/scratch/utilz-vc/host-log-<date>.md.
